brief_title: Initiation of Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Treated With Basal Insulin, in Italy
official_title: Initiation of Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Treated With Basal Insulin, in Italy

interventions.name: FreeStyle Libre 2 Flash Glucose Monitoring System

arm_groups.label: Intervention
intervention_names: Device: FreeStyle Libre 2 Flash Glucose Monitoring System

brief_summary: The goal of this clinical study is to determine the impact of starting the use of the FreeStyle Libre 2 glucose monitoring system, over a three month period, on HbA1c in adults with type 2 diabetes treated with a basal insulin regimen.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged ≥18 to ≤ 75 years.
* Type 2 diabetes diagnosis ≥1 year prior to enrolment.
* Type 2 diabetes treated with a basal insulin injection regimen with or without other antihyperglycaemic therapy at enrolment.
* Current glucose lowering treatment regimen has been established for at least 3 months prior to enrolment.
* Screening HbA1c ≥59 mmol/mol to ≤108 mmol/mol (≥7.5% and ≤12.0%, inclusive), within the last 60 days.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participant is currently prescribed prandial or pre-mixed (biphasic) insulin at enrolment.
* Currently participating in another study that could affect glucose measurements or glucose management.
* Currently receiving dialysis treatment or receives dialysis during the study.
* A female participant who is pregnant.
* A breastfeeding female participant.
